image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a bed of green moss and small plants. The salamander has a glossy black body with bright yellow irregular spots and patches distributed along its back and sides. Its body is elongated and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The head is broad and flattened, and the tail extends behind the body, appearing laterally compressed. The surrounding environment consists of dense green moss, small leafy plants, and some brown organic debris, creating a natural forest floor habitat.
